test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which industry is closely associated with 'cluster development' and the second-largest sector in terms of job creation in India after agriculture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Textile and Apparel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The textile and apparel industry is the **second-largest sector in India** in terms of job creation, after agriculture.
 
• Cluster development is a widely used strategy in this sector to **promote competitiveness and regional specialization**.
 
• The Indian textile and apparel industry contributes significantly to the **GDP, export earnings, and employment generation**.
 
• India is one of the world's largest producers of textiles and garments, with a strong presence in cotton, silk, and jute production.
 
• The industry is highly labor-intensive, employing over **45 million people directly** and around 60 million indirectly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cluster Development**

 
 
• Cluster development involves **grouping enterprises within a specific geographic location** to promote shared resources, collaboration, and innovation.
 
• It enhances productivity, competitiveness, and economies of scale for small and medium enterprises (SMEs).
 
• This approach is particularly effective in labor-intensive industries like textiles and apparel.
 
 
 
• **Contribution to Exports**
 
 
• The textile and apparel industry accounts for approximately **12% of India’s total export earnings**.
 
• India is a leading exporter of cotton textiles, garments, and home furnishings globally.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives**
 
 
• Programs like **Integrated Textile Parks** and **Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (TUFS)** aim to support the industry.
 
• The **National Technical Textiles Mission** was launched to enhance the use of technical textiles in India.
 
 
 
• **Employment Generation**
 
 
• The textile sector is a major source of employment, providing jobs to millions, particularly women in rural areas.
 
• It plays a critical role in **poverty alleviation and rural development** in India.
